answer: River-flow conservation stops bulk fake identities: each identity bonds 70 credits to one river gauge. Each epoch its beacon broadcasts a signed flow reading. At dawn auditors verify inflow equals outflow plus work, or the bond burns. A rented reading puts one key on two gauges, so both bonds burn. Each fake pays 45 plus a 70 lock; 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 75,000. An honest identity pays 45 once, keeping its share.
